mandatory_conditions.observed: All ten required strings are visible once; two name spaces contain no writing; no extra title, fake label, microtext, logo, QR code or watermark is visible.

mandatory_conditions.observed: At the actual 720x1080 view, each preparation, exclusion, eligibility, deadline and URL line is legible. Lower information area extends from approximately y660 through y1030, with separate roomy text groups rather than a miniature footer strip.

mandatory_conditions.required: 행사의 핵심은 실제 물건을 가져와 이름을 바꾸어 보는 참여다. 물건은 특정 브랜드 없이 단순하고 견고한 작은 생활 물건으로 표현할 수 있다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: One intact, unbranded metal spoon occupies the middle band, between one long blank naming rectangle and one shorter blank naming rectangle. The full bring-one-object sentence remains explicit below.

mandatory_conditions.observed: Both naming spaces are empty. No invented spoon name, translation or label text is visible.

self_observations.evidence: One horizontally fixed spoon has a long blank field directly above and a shorter blank field directly below, with shared left edges and measured gaps.
self_observations.impact: Object identity remains stable while the available naming space changes; static adjacency and scale implement the assigned relation.

self_observations.evidence: Korean title uses broad dense letterforms and two balanced lines; English title fits beside the second Korean line at substantially smaller size.
self_observations.impact: Korean title leads; English remains easy to read without diminishing the practical copy.

self_observations.evidence: Body letters are bold, naturally proportioned and high contrast; long sentences remain on readable full-width lines. Deadline punctuation, slash, middle dots and URL case are visually intact.
self_observations.impact: Practical information reads at the inspected 720-width size. Hierarchy is somewhat emphatic across the whole body, but spacing separates roles.

self_observations.location: Blank field and bilingual invitation, native y785–875
self_observations.evidence: The small empty field and adjacent two-line language invitation have an intentional clear gap with no touching outlines or characters.
self_observations.impact: Language permission connects to the act of naming rather than drifting into the footer.

self_observations.evidence: Bowl and handle form one continuous plausible spoon silhouette; restrained steel reflection, horizontal brushed marks and short shadow are coherent.
self_observations.impact: Metal remains recognisable without melting edges, plastic gloss or arbitrary decoration.

self_observations.evidence: No decorative dummy numbers, fake lettering, extra objects or repeated grain motifs are visible. A slight soft mottling is visible in the green field; it does not obscure text. The spoon is very prominent relative to the naming rectangles.
self_observations.impact: The result retains a specific object-versus-name relation. Its interpretation still benefits from the explicit headline and invitation, which remain visible.

uncertainties: Legibility was inspected at native 1024x1536 and screen reductions, not on a physical phone or a printed poster.

At 213x320 thumbnail size the title, spoon, empty fields, date and address structure remain visible, but detailed body text is too small for full reading; the phone-use criterion was inspected at 720 width.
No peer posters or external critic feedback were inspected; whole-set diversity is owned by the coordinator.

own_correction_decision.reason: No mandatory-copy or ratio defect found. Static name-space/object relation, readable practical copy and coherent material are all retained without a speculative extra sample.
